settings.question: How hot does the Sauneras steam box get?
settings.answer: The Sauneras high-output steam generator reaches up to 135°F - 145°F (57°C - 63°C) across 9-15 adjustable digital heat levels. Because steam has 100% relative humidity, 140°F feels intensely hot and induces a deep, profuse sweat equivalent to a 190°F traditional dry wooden sauna.

settings.question: How long does it take to set up and start steaming?
settings.answer: The tent uses a pop-up frame that expands in under 60 seconds. Simply place the foldable chair and sweat mat inside, fill the steamer with water, connect the insulated hose, and plug it into any wall outlet. Thick therapeutic steam starts filling the tent in just 5-8 minutes.

settings.question: Can I add essential oils or herbal botanicals?
settings.answer: Yes! Every Sauneras system includes a dedicated herbal infusion diffuser box. You can drop natural essential oils (such as eucalyptus, peppermint, lavender) or fresh dried herbs to transform your session into an authentic therapeutic aromatherapy spa.

settings.question: How do I clean and store it after a sweat session?
settings.answer: The multi-layer Oxford waterproof lining repels moisture. Simply wipe down the floor mat and interior walls with a dry microfiber cloth or antibacterial spray. Leave the zipper open for 10 minutes to dry completely, then fold it flat into its included carry duffle bag.

settings.question: What is the electrical consumption & safety certification?
settings.answer: Sauneras plugs into standard 110V/120V household wall outlets. At 1000W-1600W, a typical 25-minute session costs less than $0.15 in electricity. It features automatic dry-burn shut-off, high-pressure relief valve, and anti-leak certification.

settings.question: What is your return policy and warranty?
settings.answer: Every Sauneras comes with our 30-Day In-Home Money Back Guarantee. If you don't feel noticeably more relaxed and rejuvenated, return it for a prompt refund. You also receive a full 1-Year Manufacturer Warranty on the generator and frame.
